mapper.sql: a.appointment_id, a.patient_id, a.doctor_id, a.schedule_id, a.dept_id, a.appointment_number, a.appointment_date, a.time_slot, a.symptoms_description, a.status, a.created_at, a.completed_at, a.cancelled_at, a.cancel_reason, p.real_name, d.doctor_name, de.dept_name
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN patient p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department de ON a.dept_id = de.dept_id
(a.appointment_number LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR p.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR d.doctor_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR de.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
AND a.status = #{status}
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN patient p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department de ON a.dept_id = de.dept_id WHERE a.appointment_id = #{appointmentId}

SELECT a.*, p.real_name FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN patient p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id WHERE a.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND a.status = 'confirmed' ORDER BY a.appointment_date ASC, a.time_slot ASC
